game.title: Lint & Whiskers
game.tagline: Prowl an after-hours laundrette and bring three kittens back to the warm basket.
game.controls: Enter or click to start. WASD or arrows to move, Space to jump, Shift to prowl, F or click to meow, Esc to pause, M for sound. Touch controls are available.

session.notes: Single-session original game. Scenery, cats, animation, textures and sound were authored in code. Play requires only a static server and the repository's vendored Three.js.
